name: Junie (JetBrains)

surfaces.name: Junie CLI and IDE plugin: skill folder

notes: Junie suggests importing skills it finds in .cursor/skills, .claude/skills or .codex/skills into .junie/skills.
prerequisites: Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

docs.title: Agent skills (Junie)
docs.facts: Project <projectRoot>/.junie/skills/<name>/; user ~/.junie/skills/<name>/ (%USERPROFILE%\.junie\skills on Windows). Skills are invoked only when they match the task.

install.evidence: the installer tests (Linux) put the skill, stamp and all files in the folder this host's documentation names; the host itself was not run; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#junie-jetbrains
